name: Data Sheet Query Pattern
description: CRUD operations on internal data storage using Data Sheets node
explanation:
Pattern for Data Sheets CRUD operations (internal storage).

IMPORTANT: Data Sheets node uses type: 'dataSheets' (not 'custom').

Data Sheets operations:
- read: Query rows with filters
- insert: Insert single row
- batch-insert: Insert multiple rows from array (e.g., AI JSON output)
- update: Modify existing row
- delete: Remove row

Key settings:
- sheetId: Target data sheet ID (null if auto-created)
- operation: read/insert/batch-insert/update/delete
- filter: Query conditions (for read)
- data: Field mappings using {{variableName}} syntax
- outputVariable: Variable name to store result

For batch-insert from AI JSON output:
- AI outputs array of objects (e.g., transactions[])
- Data Sheets maps each field: {"date": "{{date}}", "amount": "{{amount}}"}
- Variables reference array item fields automatically
